Triangular Correlation Heatmap with Curved Mantel Links

Source: R/type_mantel_triangle.R
type_mantel_triangle.Rd

Creates a publication-grade lower-triangular correlation matrix of environmental or clinical variables connected via smooth bezier arcs to microbial community taxa, diversity metrics, or multi-omics modules (Wen et al. iMeta 2025).

Usage

type_mantel_triangle(
  env_cor = NULL,
  env_data = NULL,
  comm_data = NULL,
  mantel_res = NULL,
  cor_method = c("spearman", "pearson", "kendall"),
  dist_comm = "bray",
  dist_env = "euclidean",
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  r_cutoff = 0,
  show_cor_values = TRUE,
  show_sig_stars = TRUE,
  link_palette = NULL,
  link_width_range = c(0.4, 2.2),
  tile_palette = "RdBu",
  node_size = 4,
  label_size = 3,
  curve_curvature = 0.25
)

Arguments

env_cor

Optional square numeric correlation matrix or data frame of environmental variables. If NULL, correlation is computed from env_data.

env_data

Optional data frame or matrix of environmental/clinical variables (samples in rows, variables in columns).

comm_data

Optional data frame or matrix of community abundances or multi-omics profiles (samples in rows, features in columns).

mantel_res

Optional data frame of pre-computed Mantel test results with columns spec (community feature), env (environmental variable), r (correlation magnitude), and p (p-value).

cor_method

Correlation method for environmental variables: "pearson", "spearman", or "kendall".

dist_comm

Dissimilarity metric for community data if computing Mantel tests: "bray", "jaccard", or "euclidean".

dist_env

Distance metric for environmental variables: "euclidean" or "manhattan".

p_cutoff

Numeric significance threshold for drawing links (default 0.05).

r_cutoff

Numeric minimum Mantel r magnitude to display (default 0.0).

show_cor_values

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays correlation values inside triangular tiles.

show_sig_stars

Logical. If TRUE, appends significance asterisks to correlation values in tiles.

link_palette

Color palette or vector for Mantel p-values (default c("< 0.001" = "#E64B35", "< 0.01" = "#4DBBD5", "< 0.05" = "#00A087", ">= 0.05" = "#B0B5BC")).

link_width_range

Range of line widths for Mantel r values (default c(0.4, 2.2)).

tile_palette

Color palette for the environmental correlation matrix (default "RdYlBu" or "coolwarm").

node_size

Numeric point size for community nodes along the margin (default 4.0).

label_size

Numeric font size for variable and community labels (default 3.0).

curve_curvature

Numeric curvature for bezier links (default 0.25).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# With precomputed mantel results:
cliplot(type = type_mantel_triangle(env_data = env_df, mantel_res = mantel_df))
} # }
